product_overview: Gestor de ventas es un panel administrativo y API REST para pequeños y medianos negocios que necesitan vender, controlar inventario y revisar métricas desde un solo sistema. Cada venta descuenta stock de forma transaccional y deja trazabilidad auditable en inventario y dashboard.
core_goals: Autenticar usuarios y proteger el acceso a las rutas del sistema
Gestionar categorías y productos con validaciones de unicidad y permisos
Registrar ventas de forma transaccional descontando stock y auditando movimientos
Permitir cancelación de ventas y reversión automática de inventario
Exponer consultas de inventario y métricas del negocio en tiempo real
Mantener una documentación API navegable y consistente con la implementación

features.name: Authentication and session
features.description: Permite iniciar y cerrar sesión, y consultar la identidad del usuario autenticado mediante cookie httpOnly o bearer token según el contexto de uso.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with valid seeded admin credentials -> Receive 200 with user data and Set-Cookie token -> GET /api/auth/me with the session cookie -> Receive 200 with current user profile
POST /api/auth/login with wrong password -> Receive 401 with message "Credenciales invalidas"
POST /api/auth/login with malformed email or password shorter than 6 characters -> Receive 400 with message "Datos invalidos"
GET /api/auth/me without credentials -> Receive 401 unauthorized
POST /api/auth/logout -> Receive 204 and token cookie is cleared

features.name: Category CRUD
features.description: Permite listar, crear, editar y eliminar categorías del catálogo, evitando duplicados y bloqueando el borrado cuando existen productos asociados.
user_flows: GET /api/categories with a valid session -> Receive 200 with a sorted data array of categories
POST /api/categories with a unique name -> Receive 201 with the created category -> GET /api/categories/{id} -> Receive 200 with the same category
POST /api/categories with an empty name -> Receive 400 with validation error
POST /api/categories with a duplicate name -> Receive 409 with message "Ya existe una categoria con ese nombre"
PUT /api/categories/{id} with an authenticated admin session and a new unique name -> Receive 200 with updated category
PUT /api/categories/{id} with a non-admin session -> Receive 403 forbidden
DELETE /api/categories/{id} for a category with no products -> Receive 204 with empty body
DELETE /api/categories/{id} for a category that still has products -> Receive 409 with message "No se puede eliminar: hay productos asociados"
GET /api/categories/999999 for a missing category -> Receive 404 not found

features.name: Product catalog CRUD, search and pagination
features.description: Gestiona el catálogo de productos con paginación, filtros, creación con SKU único, edición parcial y borrado lógico para conservar el historial de ventas.
user_flows: GET /api/products?page=1&pageSize=20 with a valid session -> Receive 200 with data, total, page and pageSize
GET /api/products?search=seeded-fragment&categoryId={id}&isActive=true -> Receive 200 with only matching active products
GET /api/products?pageSize=101 -> Receive 400 because pageSize is outside the allowed range
POST /api/products with a valid body and unique SKU -> Receive 201 with the created product
POST /api/products with duplicate SKU -> Receive 409 with message "Ya existe un producto con ese SKU"
POST /api/products with categoryId 999999 -> Receive 404 with message "Categoria no encontrada"
PUT /api/products/{id} with admin session and partial fields such as price or stock -> Receive 200 with updated product data
PUT /api/products/{id} with a non-admin session -> Receive 403 forbidden
DELETE /api/products/{id} with admin session -> Receive 200 with the product returned as isActive false
GET /api/products?isActive=true after soft delete -> Receive 200 without the deleted product

features.name: Transactional sale creation
features.description: Crea ventas de manera atómica, validando stock, consolidando líneas repetidas, generando códigos correlativos y registrando movimientos de salida.
user_flows: POST /api/sales with one or more valid items and sufficient stock -> Receive 201 with SaleDetail, code starting with V- and status completed -> GET /api/products/{id} -> Receive 200 with reduced stock -> GET /api/inventory/movements?productId={id}&type=out -> Receive 200 with a recorded out movement
POST /api/sales with quantity larger than available stock -> Receive 409 with message "Stock insuficiente" and details.shortages array
POST /api/sales with an empty items array -> Receive 400 with validation error
POST /api/sales with discount greater than subtotal -> Receive 400 because the total cannot become negative
POST /api/sales with an unknown productId -> Receive 404 with product not found
POST /api/sales with invalid paymentMethod -> Receive 400 with validation error
POST /api/sales repeating the same productId in two lines -> Receive 201 with the quantities merged into a single item

features.name: Sale listing, detail and cancellation
features.description: Permite consultar ventas con filtros de estado y fecha, ver el detalle completo de una venta y cancelarla una sola vez con reversión de stock.
user_flows: GET /api/sales?page=1&pageSize=20 with a valid session -> Receive 200 with paginated sales ordered by id descending
GET /api/sales?status=cancelled -> Receive 200 with only cancelled sales
GET /api/sales?from=2020-01-01&to=2020-01-02 -> Receive 200 with an empty data array when no sales match
GET /api/sales/{id} -> Receive 200 with SaleDetail including items array
GET /api/sales/999999 -> Receive 404 with message "Venta no encontrada"

POST /api/sales/{id}/cancel on a completed sale -> Receive 200 with updated SaleDetail and status cancelled -> GET /api/inventory/movements?productId={id}&type=in -> Receive 200 with restored stock movement
POST /api/sales/{id}/cancel on the same sale again -> Receive 409 with message "La venta ya esta cancelada"

features.name: Inventory movements and manual stock adjustment
features.description: Expone el historial de stock y permite ajustes manuales de entrada o fijación absoluta del stock con validación de motivo y cantidad.
user_flows: GET /api/inventory/movements?page=1&pageSize=20 with a valid session -> Receive 200 with paginated movement history ordered by id descending
GET /api/inventory/movements?type=in -> Receive 200 with only in-type movements
GET /api/inventory/movements?type=bogus -> Receive 400 with validation error
GET /api/inventory/low-stock -> Receive 200 with active products whose stock is at or below minStock
POST /api/inventory/adjust with type in, positive quantity and non-empty reason -> Receive 201 with newStock equal to previousStock plus quantity
POST /api/inventory/adjust with type adjustment and a different absolute stock value -> Receive 201 with newStock set to the requested value
POST /api/inventory/adjust with type adjustment using the current stock value -> Receive 400 with message "El ajuste no cambia el stock actual"
POST /api/inventory/adjust with quantity 0 or negative, empty reason, or unknown productId -> Receive 400 or 404 depending on the invalid input

features.name: Dashboard aggregates
features.description: Entrega métricas resumidas del negocio, una serie diaria de ventas y el ranking de productos más vendidos para apoyar la toma de decisiones.
user_flows: GET /api/dashboard/summary with a valid session -> Receive 200 with todayCount, todayTotal, monthCount, monthTotal, averageTicket and lowStockCount
GET /api/dashboard/sales-chart?days=7 -> Receive 200 with a daily data array for the last 7 days
GET /api/dashboard/top-products?limit=5 -> Receive 200 with up to 5 best-selling products
GET /api/dashboard/sales-chart?days=0 -> Receive 400 because days is outside the valid range
GET /api/dashboard/top-products?limit=0 -> Receive 400 because limit is outside the valid range
GET /api/inventory/low-stock and GET /api/dashboard/summary -> Receive 200 responses where lowStockCount matches the number of low-stock products

features.name: Authorization and error contract
features.description: Aplica control de acceso a todas las rutas protegidas y estandariza las respuestas de error en JSON con statusCode y message.
user_flows: GET /api/products without credentials -> Receive 401 with message "No autenticado"
GET /api/sales with an invalid Bearer token in the Authorization header -> Receive 401 unauthorized
POST /api/products with malformed JSON body -> Receive 400 with message "JSON invalido"
GET /api/does-not-exist -> Receive 404 with message starting with "Ruta no encontrada"
Trigger any validation or business error on a protected route -> Receive JSON error payload containing statusCode and message

tech_stack: Zod 4 validation via a validate() middleware

routes.description: GET. OpenAPI 3.1 document. GET /api/docs redirects 301 to /api/docs/ which serves Swagger UI.

POST. Body {email, password}. 200 returns {user} and sets the httpOnly cookie `token`. 401 "Credenciales invalidas" on bad email or password. 400 "Datos invalidos" when email is malformed or password is shorter than 6 characters.
POST. Always 204 with an empty body and clears the `token` cookie.
GET. 200 returns {user} for the current session. 401 without a valid token.

GET returns {data: Category[]} sorted by name, no pagination. POST creates a category, 201 with the Category, 400 on an empty name, 409 "Ya existe una categoria con ese nombre" on a duplicate name. POST does NOT require the admin role.

GET returns the Category or 404. PUT updates it and requires the admin role, 200 on success, 403 for non-admin, 404 when missing, 409 on duplicate name. DELETE requires admin and returns 204 with an empty body, 404 when missing, 409 "No se puede eliminar: hay productos asociados" when the category still has products.

GET returns {data, total, page, pageSize}. Query params page (min 1, default 1), pageSize (1..100, default 20), search (matches name or SKU case-insensitively), categoryId, isActive. Invalid values return 400. POST creates a product and returns 201, 400 on a bad body, 404 "Categoria no encontrada" for an unknown categoryId, 409 "Ya existe un producto con ese SKU" on a duplicate SKU. POST does NOT require the admin role.

GET returns the Product or 404. PUT requires the admin role and accepts a partial body, 200 on success, 403 for non-admin, 404 when missing, 409 on a duplicate SKU. DELETE requires admin and performs a SOFT delete, returning 200 with the product where isActive is false, 404 when missing.

GET returns {data, total, page, pageSize} ordered by id descending. Query params page, pageSize, status (completed or cancelled), from and to as YYYY-MM-DD. POST creates a transactional sale, 201 with the SaleDetail, 400 when the discount exceeds the subtotal or when discount or tax are negative, 404 when a product is missing or inactive, 409 "Stock insuficiente" with a details.shortages array when any line exceeds available stock.
GET returns the SaleDetail with its items, or 404 "Venta no encontrada".

POST cancels a completed sale, restores stock with `in` movements and returns 200 with the updated SaleDetail. 404 when the sale is missing, 409 "La venta ya esta cancelada" when it was already cancelled.
GET returns {data, total, page, pageSize} ordered by id descending. Query params page, pageSize, productId and type (in, out or adjustment).
GET returns {data: Product[]} with active products whose stock is at or below minStock.

POST body {productId, type, quantity, reason}. type `in` ADDS quantity to the stock, while type `adjustment` SETS the stock to the absolute value of quantity. Returns 201. 404 when the product is missing, 400 "El ajuste no cambia el stock actual" when an adjustment matches the current stock, 400 on a non positive quantity or an empty reason.
GET returns {todayCount, todayTotal, monthCount, monthTotal, averageTicket, lowStockCount}. The four money fields are strings with two decimals.
GET with the query param days (1..365, default 30). Returns {data: [{date, total, count}]}. A days value outside the range returns 400.
GET with the query param limit (1..50, default 10). Returns {data: [{productId, productName, quantitySold, total}]}. A limit outside the range returns 400.

features.name: Authentication and session
features.description: Login validates the credentials with bcrypt and signs a JWT with audience "web" stored in an httpOnly cookie. Protected routes accept either that cookie or an Authorization Bearer header carrying a JWT with audience "api".

POST /api/auth/login with a wrong password and expect 401 with the message "Credenciales invalidas"

features.name: Transactional sale creation
features.description: Creating a sale locks the involved product rows, validates stock, merges duplicate lines, computes totals, generates the sequential code V-000001, decrements stock and writes `out` stock movements, all inside one database transaction.
user_interactions: POST /api/sales with one item of a product that has stock and expect 201 with a code matching V-\d{6}, status completed and a matching total
Verify the product stock decreased by the sold quantity through GET /api/products/{id}
Verify an `out` movement was recorded through GET /api/inventory/movements?productId={id}&type=out
POST /api/sales requesting a quantity larger than the stock and expect 409 with details.shortages
POST /api/sales with an empty items array and expect 400
POST /api/sales with a discount larger than the subtotal and expect 400
POST /api/sales with an unknown productId and expect 404
POST /api/sales with an invalid paymentMethod and expect 400
POST /api/sales repeating the same productId in two lines and expect the quantities to be merged into a single item

features.name: Sale listing, detail and cancellation
features.description: Sales can be listed with status and date filters, opened in detail, and cancelled once. Cancelling restores stock with `in` movements.
user_interactions: GET /api/sales and expect 200 with a paginated envelope
GET /api/sales?status=cancelled and expect every row to have status cancelled
GET /api/sales?from=2020-01-01&to=2020-01-02 and expect an empty data array
GET /api/sales/{id} and expect the SaleDetail to include an items array
GET /api/sales/999999 and expect 404
POST /api/sales/{id}/cancel on a freshly created sale and expect 200 with status cancelled
Verify the stock went back up and an `in` movement exists after the cancellation
POST /api/sales/{id}/cancel a second time on the same sale and expect 409

features.name: Inventory movements and manual stock adjustment

user_interactions: GET /api/inventory/movements and expect a paginated envelope
GET /api/inventory/movements?type=in and expect every row to have type in
GET /api/inventory/movements?type=bogus and expect 400
GET /api/inventory/low-stock and expect a data array where every product has stock at or below minStock

POST /api/inventory/adjust with an unknown productId and expect 404

user_interactions: GET /api/dashboard/summary and expect the six fields with money values formatted as strings with two decimals
GET /api/dashboard/sales-chart?days=7 and expect a data array of daily points
GET /api/dashboard/sales-chart?days=0 and expect 400
GET /api/dashboard/sales-chart?days=400 and expect 400
GET /api/dashboard/top-products?limit=5 and expect at most 5 entries
GET /api/dashboard/top-products?limit=0 and expect 400
Confirm lowStockCount in the summary equals the length of the GET /api/inventory/low-stock data array

features.name: Authorization and error contract
features.description: Every /api route except auth requires a session. Editing and deleting products and categories additionally requires the admin role. Errors always return a JSON body with statusCode and message.
user_interactions: Call any /api/products, /api/sales, /api/inventory or /api/dashboard route with no credential and expect 401 with the message "No autenticado"
Send malformed JSON to any POST endpoint and expect 400 with the message "JSON invalido"
Request an unknown path such as GET /api/does-not-exist and expect 404 with a message starting with "Ruta no encontrada"
Confirm every error response carries a statusCode field and a message field

known_limitations.issue: Only one user exists in the seeded database and it has the admin role
known_limitations.impact: The 403 branch of requireRole cannot be exercised end to end, because there is no seller account to authenticate as. Tests must not assume a non-admin user.

known_limitations.issue: POST /api/products and POST /api/categories do not call requireRole("admin")
known_limitations.impact: Creation is open to any authenticated user while update and delete are admin only. This asymmetry is intentional in the current code, so a test expecting 403 on creation would be wrong.

known_limitations.issue: Product deletion is a soft delete
known_limitations.impact: DELETE returns 200 with the product rather than 204, the row stays in the table and its SKU remains reserved, so recreating the same SKU afterwards returns 409.

known_limitations.issue: The type "adjustment" on /api/inventory/adjust sets an absolute stock value instead of adding a delta
known_limitations.impact: Tests must not assume that an adjustment adds to the current stock. The recorded movement quantity is the absolute difference between the old and the new stock.

known_limitations.issue: GET /api/categories, /api/inventory/low-stock, /api/dashboard/sales-chart and /api/dashboard/top-products return a bare data-only envelope without total, page or pageSize
known_limitations.impact: These four endpoints do not follow the paginated envelope used by products, sales and movements, so assertions must not require total, page or pageSize on them.

known_limitations.issue: Sale codes are generated from the last inserted code inside an advisory lock
known_limitations.impact: The seed inserts codes shaped V-DEMO-NN, so the next generated code falls back to V-000001 when the latest row is a demo sale. Tests should assert the V- prefix rather than an exact sequence number.

known_limitations.issue: The test database holds seeded demo data
known_limitations.impact: Categories, products and 100 sales coded V-DEMO-01 to V-DEMO-100 already exist. Tests must create their own records with unique suffixes and must not delete seeded rows.
